basics.description: Deploy AOAI Foundry Proxy on Azure Container Instances. The default path uses Azure Database for PostgreSQL for config persistence; Azure Files and Blob remain available for storage-backed deployments.

basics.name: containerGroupName
basics.label: Container group name
basics.toolTip: Name of the Azure Container Instance group.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 1-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, and do not end with a hyphen.

basics.name: dnsNameLabel
basics.label: Public DNS label
basics.toolTip: Optional public DNS label for the container group. Leave empty to skip a public DNS name.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 1-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.

elements.name: cpu
elements.label: CPU cores
elements.toolTip: CPU cores assigned to the container group.

elements.name: memoryInGb
elements.label: Memory
elements.toolTip: Memory assigned to the container group.

elements.name: persistenceMode
elements.label: Persistence mode
elements.toolTip: Database is the default and creates PostgreSQL-backed config persistence. Azure Files and Blob remain available for storage-backed modes.

allowedValues.label: PostgreSQL config persistence
allowedValues.description: Create Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server and persist config there. Database name can be left empty to auto-create the default database.

allowedValues.label: Azure Files volume
allowedValues.description: Mount /app/data from Azure Files. Requires shared key access.

allowedValues.label: Blob config persistence
allowedValues.description: Persist config in Blob Storage by managed identity.

elements.name: storageAccountMode
elements.label: Storage account source
elements.toolTip: Choose whether the deployment should create a storage account or reuse an existing one.

allowedValues.label: Create new storage account
allowedValues.description: Recommended when policy allows storage creation in this resource group.

allowedValues.label: Use existing storage account
allowedValues.description: Avoids changing storage account creation behavior when policy requires pre-provisioned storage.

options.text: Choose whether to create a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server or connect to an existing one. The deployment always injects the final connection string into the container as a secure environment variable.

elements.name: databaseServerMode
elements.label: PostgreSQL server source
elements.toolTip: Choose whether the deployment should create a PostgreSQL server or reuse an existing one.

allowedValues.label: Create new PostgreSQL server
allowedValues.description: Creates a Flexible Server and a database in the current resource group.

allowedValues.label: Use existing PostgreSQL server
allowedValues.description: Reuses a pre-created Flexible Server and avoids server creation in policy-restricted environments.

elements.name: databaseServerName
elements.label: PostgreSQL server name
elements.toolTip: Server name to create or reuse. Leave empty to auto-generate only when creating a new server.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.

elements.name: databaseMode
elements.label: Database source
elements.toolTip: Choose whether to create the database on the existing server or connect to an existing database.

allowedValues.label: Create database on existing server
allowedValues.description: Useful when the server already exists but the AOAI Proxy database does not.

allowedValues.label: Use existing database
allowedValues.description: Avoids database creation when policy requires a fully pre-provisioned PostgreSQL setup.

elements.name: databaseName
elements.label: Database name
elements.toolTip: Database name to create or reuse. Leave empty to auto-create aoaiproxy only when creating a new database.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use a PostgreSQL-compatible database name.

elements.name: databaseAdminUsername
elements.label: Database username
elements.toolTip: Username used in the application connection string. For existing servers, use a login that already has access to the target database.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 1-63 letters or numbers and start with a letter.

toolTip.password: Password used in the application connection string.

elements.name: databaseSkuName
elements.label: Database size
elements.toolTip: Burstable development sizes for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server.

options.text: Choose whether to create new storage resources or reuse existing ones. Existing-resource mode is useful when Azure Policy requires storage accounts or shares to be pre-provisioned.

elements.name: storageAccountName
elements.label: Storage account name
elements.toolTip: Name of the storage account to create or reuse. Leave empty to auto-generate only when creating a new account.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3-24 lowercase letters or numbers. The name must be globally unique in Azure Storage.

elements.name: fileShareMode
elements.label: Azure Files share source
elements.toolTip: Choose whether the deployment should create the Azure Files share or reuse an existing one.

allowedValues.label: Create file share
allowedValues.description: Creates a share in the existing storage account.

allowedValues.label: Use existing file share
allowedValues.description: Avoids creating a new share when policy requires a fully pre-provisioned Azure Files setup.

elements.name: fileShareName
elements.label: Azure Files share name
elements.toolTip: Used only when Azure Files persistence is selected.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.

elements.name: blobContainerMode
elements.label: Blob container source
elements.toolTip: Choose whether the deployment should create the Blob container or reuse an existing one.

allowedValues.label: Create Blob container
allowedValues.description: Creates the container in the existing storage account.

allowedValues.label: Use existing Blob container
allowedValues.description: Avoids container creation when policy requires a fully pre-provisioned Blob setup.

elements.name: blobContainerName
elements.label: Blob container name
elements.toolTip: Used only when Blob persistence is selected.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.

elements.name: configBlobName
elements.label: Config blob path
elements.toolTip: Blob path for the persisted config file.

options.text: Select an existing `Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts` resource. Cross-resource-group selection is supported within the selected subscription.

elements.name: cognitiveAccount
elements.label: Existing Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry account

elements.name: acrLoginServer
elements.label: ACR login server
elements.toolTip: Leave empty for a public image registry.

elements.name: acrUsername
elements.label: ACR username
elements.toolTip: Required only when the registry needs basic authentication.
